actions.name: add_guild_member
actions.description: Add a user to a Discord guild using an OAuth2 access token that user granted to this bot's application with the guilds.join scope.

actions.name: begin_guild_prune
actions.description: Remove inactive members from a Discord guild. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD and KICK_MEMBERS permissions. Set compute_prune_count to false for large guilds.

days.description: The number of days of inactivity that qualifies a member for pruning. Discord defaults to 7.

compute_prune_count.description: Whether Discord returns the number of pruned members. Discord defaults to true.

include_roles.description: Role ids whose holders may also be pruned. By default members with any role are skipped.

audit_log_reason.description: The reason recorded in the guild audit log for this change.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for pruning members.

anyOf.description: The number of members removed, or null when compute_prune_count is false.

pruned.description: The number of members removed, or null when compute_prune_count is false.

actions.name: bulk_guild_ban
actions.description: Ban up to 200 users from a Discord guild at once. Requires the BAN_MEMBERS and MANAGE_GUILD permissions.

banned_users.description: The user ids that were banned.
